subject.title: 一个现实的问题，很多人将面临无法访问github

question: Should this issue be handled as off-topic referral promotion, or should maintainers request a separately scoped GitHub-reachability proposal?
rationale: Repository evidence cannot safely infer a product request from the referral link, and only a human can choose the moderation response or invite a new security-bounded proposal.

options.title: Moderate as off-topic
options.body: Handle the referral through normal moderation and do not interpret it as a ClawHub feature request.

options.title: Request a scoped proposal
options.body: Ask for a new report naming the blocked ClawHub flow and defining whether proxy, mirror, or alternate-auth behavior is needed.

recommendation.title: Moderate as off-topic
recommendation.body: Handle the referral through normal moderation and do not interpret it as a ClawHub feature request.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent connection to both the adjacent runtime paths and the repository's active content-policy work.
